com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc

Class DbcCodes

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.managers.dbc.DbcCodes

  • public class DbcCodes
extends java.lang.Object
    The DbcCodes only implements the DBCAPI static codes that are useful for Java API. Other codes are not exposed via DbcCodes in order to reduce complexity and increase simplicity. Original C++ codes are in Hex values which can be seen at com.esignal.jstandard.jna.constants.DbcAPICodes. If the internal code do not match with any of the DbcCodes then the Enum value will be DbcCodes.UNKNOWN.STATUS. Call UNKNOWN#STATUS.code() in order to get the internal code value. The client is responsible to report any DbcCodes.UNKNOWN.STATUS if their requirement is to handle the error gracefully.

    These codes are only applicable to ResourceManagerFactory.IMPLEMENTATION.DBC implementation.
